question: Do Montgomery census tracts with more code violations this year also have more adults with high blood pressure?

analysis.reason: The question asks whether tracts with more code violations also have more adults with high blood pressure, which is a cross-tract association. Per guidance, cross-tract associations must use population-adjusted rates: code violations per 1,000 residents (totalpopulation) compared with the CDC adult high-blood-pressure prevalence percentage. Tract population is carried with the health estimate and included as the denominator measure.
analysis.rank_measure: code violations per 1,000 residents, descending, paired with high-blood-pressure prevalence by tract
